messages:
Ivy Torres: quick sync  i'm seeing mixed terminology across migration guides and SDK snippets: 'model family', 'model series', and 'model line' all used. can we pick one canonical term for the docs?
Ben Chu: prefer 'model family' (clear and already in a few places). +1 to adding a short parenthetical on first mention: e.g., Model Family (e.g., Llama2).
Fiona Grant: agree. also noticed SDK examples sometimes use `model` param ambiguously when they mean variant. suggestion: keep `model` for the model identifier and add `model_variant` when referring to size/quantization. show both in examples.
Ivy Torres: good call. proposal: canonical copy = 'model family' and 'model variant'. in SDKs: python -> model_variant, js -> modelVariant. include both old->new migration snippets.
Ben Chu: for migration, show a one-line shim that maps the old `variant` param to `model_variant` and log a deprecation warning. small example for migration doc: ```py
# shim (temporary)
def _norm(kwargs):
    if 'variant' in kwargs:
        kwargs.setdefault('model_variant', kwargs.pop('variant'))
    return kwargs
```
Fiona Grant: i'll draft glossary entries and add frontmatter synonyms so search finds 'model series' and 'model line'. also add a short sentence distinguishing 'variant' vs 'version' (variant = size/quant/compile, version = semantic model update).
doc-ops-bot: Auto: created issue #1422 "glossary: canonicalize model family/variant + SDK param guidance" (https://github.com/redwood/docs/issues/1422).
Ivy Torres: action items: Fiona = glossary + redirects, Ben = SDK snippet sweep and migration doc, me = changelog blurb and in-page examples. timeline: snippets + migration by Fri, glossary + redirects by Mon, changelog by next Tue.
Ben Chu: small style note: in examples keep python snake_case, JS camelCase. include explicit examples showing both `model` (identifier) and `model_variant` so readers don't confuse them.
Fiona Grant: one more nit: Console microcopy currently says "Model series" in the model selector. i'll open a tiny frontend PR to change label to "Model family" and update tooltip: "Model family groups related models (e.g., Llama2). Use the Variant dropdown to pick size/compile."
Ivy Torres: thanks. final ask: can we also add a short lint rule to flag 'model series' and 'model line' so we don't regress? Fiona can add that with the glossary PR.
Fiona Grant: yep i'll add a regex lint and a short testing step. closing thread when PRs are merged. /me adds checklist to issue: [ ] SDK snippets, [ ] migration doc, [ ] glossary + redirects, [ ] changelog blurb, [ ] console label
